budget_protocol: Budgets are per arm, per input, seed and timing repetition, not total study budget. Preserve fixed work at all three caps; do not spend surplus on additional steps or samples. At seven pairs, 32 seeds, one input and three budgets, maximum paired allocation per method is 2*7*32*(60+120+240)=188160 GPU_s; total across three methods 564480 GPU_s. These are prospective caps, not measured costs. No stopping for significance.

confidence_rule.decision: Executable v1 exact binomial order-statistic bounds only. Performance: one-sided lower confidence bound for paired baseline/method wall-time ratios must exceed minimum_worthwhile_gain at each sealed budget. Equivalence: two-sided exact median paired-difference CI must lie strictly inside [-abs,+abs] for all metrics; Bonferroni across 16 metrics at family alpha=0.05, tail alpha=0.0015625. For 32 independent seed differences use sorted ranks 8 and 25, one-based. No significant difference is not equivalence. Require complete work, correct eight replica seeds/steps, finite energies, all budget points passing and no timeouts. Each method/budget is a separate claim; no pooled omnibus discovery claim. Missing output or insufficient finite bounds fails evaluation.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work molecular dynamics benchmark has no calibrated scalar energy threshold or outcome curve. Target is completion of eight 25000-step trajectories with statistical equivalence for every recorded replica mean and final potential energy, as sealed above; energy magnitude is not an optimization objective.

evidence_limits: No saved full energy series: no series-level equivalence claim.
Only one measured baseline ensemble with eight independent seeds; no same-seed repeats. Cross-seed Monte Carlo resolution cannot establish full trajectory identity.
anchors_scored.json: 1505.1158505929984 ns/day is measured fixed-work throughput; approximate published 5000 ns/day is a different fixed-time workload and has no acceptance tolerance.
No method code or method measurements exist. Bounds are ceilings from supplied profile, not expected gains. Scope, tolerance, input, seed or budget changes require new sealed run.

hardware_cost_basis.description: Same single NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 device, exclusive to paired experiment except concurrent workers within method. GPU seconds = allocated GPU count times process wall seconds, including CPU work while GPU allocated. Same driver 570.148.08 and reproduced software environment for both arms; no cross-device or multi-GPU claim.

infeasible_methods.reason: One GPU available. Equal-GPU-second Amdahl/k bound is 1 with k=1 and p=0.5576032713564045; below 1.05.
Transfers occupy p=0.003754061835505305; k=2 gives Amdahl ceiling 1.0018805607884955, below 1.05 before launch/synchronization overhead.

paired_seed_tests.description: Each execution seed is seed0 for one eight-replica fixed-work ensemble; replica i uses seed0+i for velocities and integrator RNG. Seed blocks are disjoint. Pair baseline and method on identical seed0, input and hardware. For each of 16 energy metrics take median method-minus-baseline difference over timing repetitions within each seed, then form exact order-statistic CI over 32 seed-level differences. Repetitions are not independent scientific samples. Random thermal velocities and Langevin sampling remain stochastic despite fixed seeds and DeterministicForces=true.

power.assumptions: Prospective planning assumption only: for every metric, independent seed-block paired differences have probability at most 0.025 in each tail outside its scientific margin. No measured method-difference distribution exists, so unconditional achieved power is unavailable. Baseline cross-seed SD estimates margins, not method noise.
power.calculation: For n=32 and 16 metrics, per-tail alpha=0.05/(2*16)=0.0015625 selects CI ranks 8 and 25. Union-bound failure <=32*P[Binomial(32,0.025)>=8]. No Gaussian approximation; no post hoc sample-size or margin revision.

scheduling_protocol: Deterministic PRNG with seed 8675309 randomizes arm order independently within each input/seed/budget/repetition pair and shuffles complete pair blocks over methods, budgets and seeds. Run paired arms consecutively on same allocated GPU, never overlap arms. Fix all schedules before execution; no concurrency sweep or MPS parameter search. Method concurrency fixed at four workers in two waves; baseline sequential.

development.role: Measured baseline and profile evidence; used for prospective margin calibration only.

held_out.role: Prospective paired evaluation. No held-out outputs inspected. Same fixed molecular input, independent RNG blocks; no molecular generalization claim.

splits.reason: No training split for fixed molecular-dynamics benchmark.

timing_scope.description: Adapter wall timer spans launch of all arm processes through synchronization, worker join, transfers, energy retrieval, ordered merge and final output completion. Include imports, input loading, system/context creation, RNG initialization, compilation incurred within execution, integration, destruction, serialization and orchestration. Baseline uses identical enclosing scope. Excludes only shared environment installation and pre-staged immutable inputs. Baseline reported 45.923375248999946 s and profile 47.537998489000074 s are different measured scopes, not substituted for future paired process-wall observations.

warmup_protocol: Zero discarded runs per arm. Each timed execution uses fresh processes and contexts; no untimed integration or hidden compilation run. Preserve common pre-existing cache state at pair start; randomize arm order to balance residual cache/thermal effects.
